spec.query:
from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["dest_ip", "dst_port", "service"])
  |> sum()
  |> top(n: 10, columns: ["_value"])
  |> yield(name: "top_talkers")

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bandwidth_mbps")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "bant_genisligi")

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "packets_per_second")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "bant_genisligi")

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source_ip"] =~ /^192\.168\.|^10\.|^172\./)
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "Upload")

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["dest_ip"] =~ /^192\.168\.|^10\.|^172\./)
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "Download")

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes" or r["_field"] == "latitude" or r["_field"] == "longitude")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time", "dest_ip", "service"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.latitude and exists r.longitude and exists r.bytes)
  |> group() 
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "dest_ip", "service", "latitude", "longitude", "bytes"])

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: -5s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_summary" and r._field == "bandwidth_mbps")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_summary" and r._field == "packets_per_second")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["protocol"])
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["source_ip", "dest_ip"]) // Kim kiminle konuşuyor ayır
  |> sum() // Toplam sömürdükleri veriyi hesapla
  |> group() // Sıralama yapabilmek için tabloyu tek parça yap
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true) // En çoktan en aza sırala
  |> limit(n: 10) // Sadece en çok veri yiyen ilk 10 kişiyi göster

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> sum()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true) // YENİ: En çoktan en aza sırala!

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rtt_ms")

from(bucket: "network_stats") 
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "packet_loss")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "paket_kaybi")

from(bucket: "network_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "network_traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "toplam_veri")
